theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 3 群

items.colloc: watch the evening news 收看晚間新聞 | report the evening news 報導晚間新聞
items.distinct: daily news 日報 | breaking news 即時新聞
ex: The evening news will start in ten minutes.
晚間新聞將在十分鐘後開始。
She discussed the report featured on the evening news.
她討論了晚間新聞報導的那則報告。
Make sure to record the evening news for the manager.
務必幫經理錄下晚間新聞。

items.colloc: visit a film studio 參觀製片廠 | work at a film studio 在製片廠工作
items.distinct: recording studio 錄音室 | art studio 美術工作室
ex: The actor visited the film studio for a rehearsal.
那位演員到電影製片廠進行彩排。
This film studio produces high-quality documentaries annually.
這家電影製片廠每年製作高品質紀錄片。
They are scouting locations near the local film studio.
他們正在當地電影製片廠附近尋找場地。

items.colloc: offer free parking 提供免費停車 | limited free parking 有限的免費車位
items.distinct: paid parking 付費停車 | valet parking 代客泊車
ex: The shopping mall provides free parking for all customers.
這家購物中心為所有顧客提供免費停車。
Guests staying at our hotel are entitled to free parking.
入住我們飯店的房客享有免費停車權益。
Please note that free parking is available on weekends only.
請注意僅在週末提供免費停車。

items.colloc: use a frying pan 使用平底鍋 | clean the frying pan 清洗平底鍋
items.distinct: saucepan 燉鍋 | baking sheet 烤盤
ex: Place the frying pan on the stove over medium heat.
將平底鍋放在爐子上以中火加熱。
The chef reached for a large frying pan to sauté vegetables.
主廚拿了一個大平底鍋來炒蔬菜。
This non-stick frying pan is easy to wash after cooking.
這款不沾平底鍋烹飪後很容易清洗。

items.colloc: stop at a gas station 在加油站停車 | work at a gas station 在加油站工作
items.distinct: service area 服務區 | charging station 充電站
ex: We need to stop at the gas station before the highway.
我們上高速公路前得先在加油站停車。
The gas station is currently undergoing major renovations.
該加油站目前正在進行重大整修。
He bought some snacks at the gas station convenience store.
他在加油站的便利商店買了一些零食。

items.colloc: expect to get a phone call 等待一通電話 | get a phone call from a client 接到客戶電話
items.distinct: make a phone call 打電話 | return a phone call 回電
ex: I expect to get a phone call from HR regarding my application.
我預計會接到人資關於我申請的電話。
Did you get a phone call from the regional manager today?
你今天有接到區域經理的電話嗎？
She had to leave the meeting to get a phone call.
她為了接一通電話不得不離開會議。

items.colloc: get used to the schedule 適應行程 | get used to the new software 習慣新軟體
items.distinct: be used to 已經習慣 | use to 過去曾經
ex: It takes time to get used to the new office environment.
適應新的辦公環境需要一些時間。
Employees are slowly getting used to the updated company policy.
員工們正在慢慢習慣更新後的公司政策。
I have finally gotten used to the morning commute time.
我終於習慣了早上的通勤時間。

items.colloc: in addition to that 除了那之外 | furthermore, in addition 此外
items.distinct: in addition 此外 | in addition to 除了...之外
ex: The software is fast; in addition, it is very user-friendly.
該軟體運行速度快；此外，它也非常易於使用。
We need more staff; in addition, we need better equipment.
我們需要更多員工；此外，我們還需要更好的設備。
The proposal is well-written; in addition, it is cost-effective.
這份企劃書寫得很好；此外，它具備成本效益。

items.colloc: in addition to the salary 除了薪水 | in addition to the project 除了專案
items.distinct: except for 除了...之外（不包含）| apart from 除了...之外
ex: In addition to the base salary, we offer performance bonuses.
除了基本薪資外，我們還提供績效獎金。
She speaks French in addition to her native language.
除了母語之外，她還會說法語。
In addition to the main presentation, we will host a Q&A.
除了主要簡報外，我們還會舉辦問答環節。

items.colloc: in case of emergency 緊急情況下 | in case of delay 若發生延誤
items.distinct: in case 以防萬一 | in the event of 如果發生
ex: In case of power failure, please use the emergency stairs.
如果發生停電，請使用緊急逃生梯。
Notify the manager in case of any technical problems.
如果發生任何技術問題，請通知經理。
Keep this document safe in case of a future audit.
請妥善保管這份文件，以備日後的審計。

items.colloc: in order to succeed 為了成功 | in order to improve 為了改善
items.distinct: so as to do 為了 | for the purpose of 為了
ex: We must cut costs in order to remain competitive.
我們必須削減成本以保持競爭力。
The team worked overtime in order to meet the deadline.
團隊為了趕上截止期限而加班。
They invested in training in order to boost productivity.
他們投資培訓以提升生產力。

items.colloc: in short, the plan failed 簡而言之，計畫失敗了 | to sum up, in short 總結來說
items.distinct: in brief 簡短地 | to be brief 簡單來說
ex: In short, we need to increase our marketing efforts.
簡而言之，我們需要加強行銷力道。
The results were poor; in short, we need a new strategy.
結果很差；總之，我們需要一個新策略。
In short, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
簡而言之，該專案提前完成了。

items.colloc: in total cost 總成本 | a total of 總數為
items.distinct: all in all 總而言之 | on the whole 整體而言
ex: There were twenty participants in total at the seminar.
研討會總共有二十位參加者。
The order will cost five hundred dollars in total.
這筆訂單總共花費五百美元。
We have collected fifty survey responses in total so far.
到目前為止，我們總共收集了五十份調查回覆。

items.colloc: currently in use 目前使用中 | keep it in use 繼續使用
items.distinct: out of use 停止使用 | for use 供使用
ex: This meeting room is currently in use by the finance team.
這間會議室目前由財務團隊使用中。
The old machinery is still in use at the factory.
那台舊機器目前在工廠仍在使用中。
Check if the printer is in use before sending files.
傳送檔案前請確認印表機是否在使用中。

items.colloc: wait just for a minute 等一下 | step out just for a minute 離開一分鐘
items.distinct: in a minute 立刻 | every minute 每分鐘
ex: Could you step outside just for a minute to discuss this?
你能出來一下談談這個嗎？
I will be ready to start the presentation just for a minute.
我只要一分鐘就能準備好開始簡報。
The manager was away just for a minute to get water.
經理離開一下去拿水，只需要一分鐘。

items.colloc: leave a message on the machine 在電話留言 | leave a message for the secretary 給秘書留言
items.distinct: send a message 傳送訊息 | write a note 寫便條
ex: If I am not at my desk, please leave a message.
如果我不在座位上，請留言給我。
She decided to leave a message for her supervisor.
她決定給主管留個口信。
Please leave a message after the beep on the answering machine.
請在聽到提示音後於答錄機上留言。

items.colloc: look after the business 照看生意 | look after the guest 招待賓客
items.distinct: take care of 處理/照顧 | look for 尋找
ex: Who will look after the office while you are traveling?
你出差時誰會負責照看辦公室？
He was hired to look after the company's financial records.
他被聘請來負責管理公司的財務紀錄。
The assistant will look after the clients during the event.
助理將在活動期間負責接待客戶。

items.loc: put on display 展示 | currently on display 目前展示中
items.distinct: on sale 特價中 | in stock 有庫存
ex: The new product designs are on display in the lobby.
新產品設計正在大廳展示中。
Several rare paintings are on display at the art gallery.
幾幅稀有畫作正在藝廊陳列展示。
Are these items currently on display for the customers?
這些商品目前有在為顧客進行展示嗎？

items.colloc: have access to information 獲取資訊 | have access to resources 使用資源
items.distinct: approach 靠近 | approach 方法
ex: Employees have access to the company database from home.
員工可以從家中存取公司資料庫。
Only authorized staff have access to this secured area.
僅有授權員工能進入此安全區域。
We all have access to the latest market research reports.
我們都能獲取最新的市場研究報告。

items.colloc: go on vacation 去度假 | be on vacation 休假中
items.distinct: on leave 請假 | on business 出差
ex: The department head is currently on vacation until Friday.
部門主管目前休假直到星期五。
Many employees choose to go on vacation during the summer.
許多員工選擇在夏季期間去度假。
I am planning to be on vacation for two weeks in July.
我計畫在七月休假兩個星期。
